review_locator: PMCID:PMC2727416, GM-CSF receptor signaling review; PMCID:PMC5983187, beta-common cytokine review
primary_title: Identification of a 14-3-3 binding sequence in the common beta chain of the granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF), interleukin-3 (IL-3), and IL-5 receptors that is serine-phosphorylated by GM-CSF
decision_basis: Primary co-immunoprecipitation, GST-14-3-3zeta pull-down and phosphopeptide assays establish direct phospho-Ser585-dependent CSF2RB/beta-c association; the receptor-tail motif is linked to bounded hematopoietic survival signaling
limitations_preserved: Preserve beta-common receptor Ser585 and 14-3-3zeta isoform, GM-CSF dose/survival-switch context, mutual exclusivity with pY577-SHC1, and no SCI or terminal-TF inference
